title: the tester's reach mapping walks the component tree once
intention: _reached maps a proof's reach with one address.components_of call, so the mapping walks the component tree once however many files a run touched.
why: Measured 2026-11-12: component_of re-walks the tree each call (~8.5 ms); _reached calls it once per distinct file, and a sibling call site doing the same wedged the home bus at 100% of one core.
traces_to: Law 1 (the settled component set re-derived per file is a defect).
how: Collect distinct real paths as now, then one components_of over the proof and those paths. aa7a1d7fa671's tooth 1 counts component_dirs walks (want 1) instead of component_of calls (want 3).

clauses.claim: _reached over 1,200 entries naming two distinct files walks component_dirs exactly once
the map it returns equals the map over the two files given once each

decisions.text: D1: _reached calls components_of once over the proof and the distinct real paths under pkg.

D2: aa7a1d7fa671's tooth 1 counts address.component_dirs walks and wants 1 (was component_of calls, want 3: three walks), a stricter bound on the same property; PROVES maps this ticket's keys to the existing teeth.
